The ArmorIQ SDK binds tool names to the signed plan; argument/resource binding is enforced by RewindSafe immutable manifests and grant scope. Decisions labeled rewindsafe.* or postgres.* were made by RewindSafe or PostgreSQL, not by ArmorIQ.

Telemetry 'delivered' means the ArmorIQ audit endpoint returned an HTTP status below 400 for the report; the SDK itself swallows errors, so unverified reports are marked failed. Offline reports are 'skipped'.
Identities are local demo identities (cookie sessions), not enterprise SSO.
This evidence is exported from the application database and is not independently signed.
